scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 33 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-pestenacker-pilgrimage-church-of-.story: A 331 km round trip from Geltendorf - roughly 5 h 42 in the saddle. On the way it passes Water Management System of Augsburg, Rose Island, Pilgrimage Church of Wies and back through Rose Island. The highest point is about 1,100 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
